title: Simple Step to Increase Gibson Assembly Efficiency
author: Eric Danner
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be9cjh2w

steps.title: Perform Gibson Assembly
steps.instruction: Perform a standard Gibson assembly and incubate the reaction in a PCR machine for 60 minutes at 50°C.

steps.title: Purify Assembled DNA
steps.instruction: Remove the assemblies and perform a PCR quickchange or gel extract column purification to remove the Gibson Assembly solution while retaining the DNA (e.g., 100ng).

substeps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA in 15-20µl of TE or water.

steps.title: Transform Bacteria
steps.instruction: Transform bacteria using the 15-20µl of assembled plasmid via heat shock.

substeps.instruction: Add 200µl of media and shake for 45 minutes.

steps.title: Plate Bacteria
steps.instruction: Plate the bacteria on Carb plates immediately.
